Örneğin Ezhan Karaşan'ın sınıfı internetteki videoları izleyerek tahmini ne zaman quiz geleceğini ve quizde ne sorulacağını bilebiliyor, bizim böyle bir şansımız yok ve Tuğrul hoca da çok fazla quiz yapıyor. Örneğin perşembe günkü midterm'ün ertesi günü derste quiz yapması çok hatalıydı, çok acımasızcaydı: biz bütün hafta bu midterm'e çalıştık ve diğer işlerimizi midterm'ün sonrasına erteledik. Ben mesela midterm'den çıktım ve bitirme projesi için laba gittim, ertesi güne yetişmesi gereken işlerimle uğraştım ve gece 4'te eve gittim. Bunu göz önüne almalıydı, biz midterm'e çalışırken diğer işlerimizi de midterm'ün sonrasına ertelemiştik ve derse gelemeyince de quiz kaçırmış olduk. This course needs a standard quiz model across sections. It is simply unfair for one section to receive quizzes in very predictable times and in less numbers while the other section gets more quizzes in seemingly totally random times (the lowest quizzes are not even dropped for the section that recieves more quizzes!) The catalog system is inferior to the curve/avg. system in every way possible and I am not sure why it still exists in this day and age, especially for this class where the standards across sections always shift. It is an unfair and punishing system. It works for highly standardized foreign language classes in Bilkent but for a computer science class that is available for a lot of other departments, it does not.

This course deserves much more attention from the faculty since the subjects are non-trivial for real CS engineering. The book of the course is written by a virtuoso of the art and it is very beneficial for real engineering research. The subjects were not easy to deal with since it was requiring much more effective usage of Math courses in real world. This course showed me that our faculty needs more focus on applied areas. Also, some pre-required linear algebra subjects were not part of the curriculum of MATH 225 course. It would be much more effective if we had a chance to apply the subjects that we learn in courses like MATH 225 or MATH 230 while taking these courses and it would be a lot easier to understand these kind of courses where the main focus is on application of the subject. Still I recommend this course to all my peers who really wants to grasp the applied engineering mentality. It will be a lot beneficial to get an average grade from this course, rather than getting a higher grade from some relatively easy courses.
*Maybe some extra materials (like example questions) should be given to students who take this course, since it is very hard to find some extra material about this subject.
